def VTask.IsMinBadSeq {α : Type*} (r : α → α → Prop) (rk : α → ℕ) (s : Set α) (n : ℕ) (f : ℕ → α) : Prop :=
  let is_bad_seq := fun g => (∀ i, g i ∈ s) ∧ (∀ i j, r (g i) (g j) → i = j)
  let is_min_at_pos := fun g => (∀ i < n, g i = f i) ∧ 
    (∀ h : ℕ → α, (∀ i < n, h i = g i) → (∀ i, h i ∈ s) → 
     (∀ i j, r (h i) (h j) → i = j) → 
     ¬(∃ k < n, r (h k) (h k)) →
     ¬(rk (h n) < rk (g n)))
  is_bad_seq f ∧ is_min_at_pos f
